name: Reflejo Especular
algorithm: Specular Altalight — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes specular highlights for deepfake detection:

1. **Highlight Detección**: Specular highlights (bright spots from direct light reflection) are detected across the frame on all surfaces — skin, eyes, glasses, jewelry, objects. Highlights are identified by local maximum intensity exceeding neighbors by a threshold.

2. **Highlight - Luz Source Consistencia**: All specular highlights in the scene should be consistent with the same light source configuration. Using highlight positions and surface geometry, the method estimates implied light directions. All highlights should point to consistent light source positions. Deepfakes may produce highlights with inconsistent implied light directions.

3. **Highlight Shape Análisis**: The shape of specular highlights encodes surface curvature — highlights on flat surfaces appear as points, on curved surfaces as elongated reflections following surface curvature. The method checks highlight shapes against estimated surface geometry. AI-generated highlights may have shapes inconsistent with the underlying geometry.

4. **Highlight Intensity & Physics**: Specular highlight intensity follows the Fresnel equations — brighter at grazing angles, with material-dependent characteristics. The method verifies highlight intensity follows physical reflectance models. AI generators may produce highlights with incorrect intensity patterns.

5. **Temporal Highlight Dynamics**: As objects move, specular highlights should move according to the changing reflection angle. The method tracks highlight motion — highlights should move faster than texture features for convex surfaces (virtual image effect). Incorrect highlight dynamics indicate AI generation without proper reflectance modeling.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante specular highlight analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
